definitions.full: H1110. balaq [ בָּלַק ] verb waste, lay waste (Assyrian balâ‡u , Pi`el destroy , Lyon Sargon 61 ; compare Arabic a desert ) — Po`el Participle without מ , suffix בּוֺלְקָהּ Isa 24:1 (|| בּוֺקֵק , subject ׳י , object הארץ ); — on form (which might also be Qal Participle) compare Ol § 254 Lag GN 1882, 403 ; also בקק Po. Jer 51:2 , and intensive use of Infinitive absolute Niph`al Isa 24:3 ; further Punic (i.e. intensive) Participle Nahum 2:11 (this however perhaps largely influenced by assonance). Pu`al Participle מְבֻלָּקָ֑ה Nahum 2:11 ( ומב וּמְבוּקָה ׳בּוּקָה ), devastated , or as substantive a devastated city.
